title: Beyond Multiple Choice: Evaluating Steering Vectors for Adaptive Free-Form Summarization
reasoning: The paper focuses on activation engineering techniques to control text properties like sentiment, toxicity, and readability in LLM-generated summaries. While toxicity is a safety/ethical category, the paper's primary focus is on the technical efficacy of control methods and text quality trade-offs, rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical belief systems or philosophical frameworks.
